v0.4.3 — Correct BeiDou GEO and GLONASS positions
Satellite positions from broadcast ephemeris, fixed while geoveil-cn0 ran inside the EuroVeil monitoring platform.

- BeiDou GEO satellites (C01–C05 and C59 onwards) now use the transformation from the BeiDou ICD. They were about 3,700 km off, a few degrees of elevation in Europe.
- BeiDou orbits now use BeiDou time for toe (GPS time − 14 s). MEO and IGSO satellites were about 44 km along track.
- A GLONASS record is now used up to 4 h from its reference time (it was 1 h to pick a record and 2 h to propagate it). Satellites no longer drop out when a merged daily BRDC file runs about an hour behind.

```bash
pip install -U geoveil-cn0
```

**Links:** [Website](https://miluta7.github.io/geoveil-cn0/) · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/geoveil-cn0/0.4.3/) · [Changelog](https://github.com/miluta7/geoveil-cn0/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
